why: This is a study-specific adaptation of the SGAV language-teaching method for C1 students' audiovisual vocabulary treatment, not a distinct general learning theory.

Student-generated learning-material tasks are a narrower form of learning by producing, and this source adds evidence that production activities need explicit guidance, feasible scheduling, formative feedback, and instructional support.

claims.verifier: The claim directly concerns learners’ enjoyment and stress while preparing student-produced multimedia materials, an experience of the page’s production practice.
The claim directly concerns learner difficulties while producing student-generated multimedia materials, especially planning, time management, and resource access.

why: Structured Group Feedback Sessions are a curriculum-evaluation variant of Structured Discussion, using staged individual reflection, peer exchange, and facilitator-guided whole-group discussion.
